command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group inventory-readers =="
sudo -n groupadd -f inventory-readers

echo "== create user inventorysvc =="
if ! id inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -r -M -s /sbin/nologin -g inventorysvc inventorysvc 2>/dev/null || sudo -n useradd -r -M -s /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
fi

echo "== ensure inventorysvc in inventory-readers (not required but harmless if needed) =="
id inventorysvc

echo "== chown recursively =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory

echo "== chmod: dirs 750, files 640 =="

sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} +
